 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Satyendra Rai, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Braj Kishore Pd.(APP)
 Mr.Harshit Griyaghey / Mr. Akshay Ashi  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP and learned counsel for opposite party no. 2.
2.
The petitioner, husband of opposite party no. 2, apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 323, 498A, 406, 120B, 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Earlier, the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre of this Court to explore the possibility of settlement between the parties and thereafter, the Mediator, vide its report at flag 'M', has reported that the dispute between the parties has been resolved amicably through the process of mediation and both parties have agreed to live together, as husband and wife.
No.15981 of 2024(4) dt.07-10-2024 Petitioner undertakes to keep opposite party no. 2 with full respect and dignity.

sentences.text:
from today, let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M. - V, Gopalganj in connection with Gopalpur P.S. Case No. 30 of 2023, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure with condition that petitioner shall abide by all the terms & conditions, mentioned in Memorandum of Agreement,
failing which, the learned Court below would be at liberty to cancel the bail-bond of petitioner."
 (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
